# MACH Playbook

> Bilingual (Spanish & English) enterprise software architecture knowledge base authored by Lenin Meza (Senior Solutions Architect), covering Microservices, API-First contracts, Cloud-Native Kubernetes, Headless Composable Commerce, Zero-Trust Security, Distributed SQL, and FinOps.

## Interactive Engineering Tools & Reference Hubs

- [MACH Architecture Tools Hub](https://mach-playbook.github.io/tools/): Interactive MACH Maturity Evaluator, Infrastructure TCO & P99 Latency Simulator, and OpenAPI 3.1 + Token Bucket Rate-Limiting Policy Generator.
- [Author & Editorial Standards (E-E-A-T)](https://mach-playbook.github.io/about/): Credentials, laboratory validation methodology, and architectural review criteria.
- [MACH Technical Glossary](https://mach-playbook.github.io/glossary/): Bilingual A-Z dictionary of composable commerce and distributed systems terminology.
- [Ecosystem Resources](https://mach-playbook.github.io/resources/): Links to CNCF, MACH Alliance, OpenAPI 3.1, and AsyncAPI specifications.
- [Contact & Enterprise Advisory](https://mach-playbook.github.io/contact/): Direct engineering inquiry channel.
